sources.title: The 8B Parameter Reality Check: When to Use Small Models and When to ...
sources.snippet: The Agentic Threshold This is the one that matters most if you are building AI agents. If your system loops, uses tools, reads its own memory, and makes autonomous decisions, 8B is a dangerous baseline. Agentic loops require a model to accurately assess whether a task is complete — and to recognize its own failure states.
